explanation: Thinking-mode generation degenerates into rumination loops: across sampled thinking replies, all but a few hit the token limit with no \boxed{} answer. Analysis of the UNEDITED model showed: (1) failing replies are hyper-repetitive, and 64% of repeated-line instances are initiated by the doubt marker "Wait"/"wait" (also "Actually"/"Hmm"); (2) loop entry is a stochastic event at high-entropy decision points (e.g. first "Wait" sampled at logprob -2.6), after which entropy collapses to ~0.001 and the reply never recovers; (3) logit attribution at a "Wait" decision shows the logit is built mostly in layers 21-23, and resid.24 (layer-23 output) feeds ONLY the final norm/unembedding. Intervention: a rank-1 LoRA that subtracts a fixed, small bias along the mean embedding direction of the rumination tokens ("Wait"/"wait"/"Actually"/"Hmm" rows) from the final residual stream, via layer 23 model.layers.23.self_attn.o_proj and model.layers.23.mlp.down_proj. Each LoRA uses A = unit mean module-input direction (module inputs have a dominant common component, cos~0.75, so A.x is near-constant) and B = -(s/2)/c * D, giving a position-independent residual bias delta = -s*D. Calibrated s so the "Wait" logit drops ~2.7 (Wait -2.74, Actually -1.9, Hmm -1.9) while structurally common tokens rise slightly (digit "1" +0.67, "." +0.88) and math tokens are barely affected (boxed -0.26, frac -0.24). Total delta norm 0.57 (~6% of the residual norm); ||dW||/||W|| ~ 0.0015, far within the 5x bound. This suppresses the catastrophic rumination attractor at its entry point, steering thinking-mode generation toward the model's working (non-thinking-style) answering behaviour.
final_message:
Diagnosis (unedited model, thinking mode): generation almost always degenerates into repetitive rumination loops and hits the token limit with no \boxed{} answer (~1-2/16 solve). Non-thinking mode terminates cleanly and reaches ~37% accuracy, showing the model can answer but its thinking phase self-destructs.

Mechanism found: 64% of repeated-line instances in failing thinking replies are initiated by the doubt marker "Wait"/"wait" (plus "Actually"/"Hmm"). Loop entry is a stochastic event at high-entropy decision points (a low-probability "Wait" sample, e.g. logprob -2.6); once entered, entropy collapses (~0.001) and the reply never recovers. Logit attribution shows the "Wait" logit is built mostly in layers 21-23, and resid.24 (layer-23 output) feeds only the final norm/unembedding.

Adapter: rank-1 LoRA on layer 23 model.layers.23.self_attn.o_proj (A 1x2048, B 1024x1) and model.layers.23.mlp.down_proj (A 1x3584, B 1024x1), keys model.layers.23.*::A / ::B. It subtracts a position-independent bias s*D from the final residual, where D is the unit mean embedding direction of the rumination tokens (Wait/wait/Actually/Hmm). A is the unit mean module-input direction (module inputs are ~98% a common component, cos~0.75, so A.x is near-constant), and B=-(s/2)/c*D with c=median(A.x), giving delta=-s*D robustly across positions.

Calibration: s chosen so the Wait logit drops ~2.7 (Wait -2.74, " Wait" -2.87, Actually -1.9, Hmm -1.9), common structural tokens rise slightly (digit 1 +0.67, period +0.88), and math tokens are essentially untouched (boxed -0.26, frac -0.24). Total delta norm 0.57 (~6% of residual norm); ||dW||/||W|| ~ 0.0015, far below the 5x bound. Effect is confined to the final logits (layer 23 feeds nothing downstream), making it a clean, low-risk steering edit that breaks the rumination attractor at its entry point and lets thinking-mode generation fall back to the model's working answering behaviour.
